senses.gloss: पर (I) a. (f. रा) (this word is declined optionally as a pronoun in nom. and voc. pl. m. and in abl. and loc. sing. m. n. when it denotes relative position) 1. Different, varying, other, another, M.iv.133; 2. distant, removed; 3. beyond, further, म्लेच्छदेशस्ततः परः M.ii.23; 4. excellent, preeminent, chief, best, highest, e.g. परा काष्ठा; 5. higher, superior, इंद्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिंद्रियेभ्यः परं मनः । मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिः Bg.iii.42, vii.7; 6. subsequent, following, next, (with an abl.); 7. exceeding, having a remainder, (e.g. परं शतम् ‘more than a hundred’); 8. inimical, adverse; 9. last, final, R.xii.56; 10. (generally at the end of compounds) wholly engaged in, solely devoted to, completely occupied with, e.g. चिंतापर, ध्यानपर, शोकपर &c.
पर (II) m. A foe, an enemy, R.iii.21.

पर (III) n. 1. the supreme spirit; 2. final beatitude.(परम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) beyond, over, R.i.17; (2) after (generally with an abl.), शोष्यत्यस्मात्परमवहिता Megh.ii.37, R.i.66, iii.39; (3) but, however; (4) otherwise; (5) in a high degree; (6) at the utmost. परेण in the sense of- (1) farther, beyond, किं वा मृत्योः परेण विधास्यति M.M.ii.; (2) afterwards, मयि तु कृतनिघाते किं विदध्याः परेण Mv.ii. परे in the sense of ‘afterwards, thereupon.’)

पर (I) a. (f. रा) (this word is declined optionally as a pronoun in nom. and voc. pl. m. and in abl. and loc. sing. m. n. when it denotes relative position) 1. Different, varying, other, another, M.iv.133; 2. distant, removed; 3. beyond, further, म्लेच्छदेशस्ततः परः M.ii.23; 4. excellent, preeminent, chief, best, highest, e.g. परा काष्ठा; 5. higher, superior, इंद्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिंद्रियेभ्यः परं मनः । मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिः Bg.iii.42, vii.7; 6. subsequent, following, next, (with an abl.); 7. exceeding, having a remainder, (e.g. परं शतम् ‘more than a hundred’); 8. inimical, adverse; 9. last, final, R.xii.56; 10. (generally at the end of compounds) wholly engaged in, solely devoted to, completely occupied with, e.g. चिंतापर, ध्यानपर, शोकपर &c.
परा ind. A prefix to verbs implying- (1) overcoming; (2) liberation; (3) inverted order; (4) pride; (5) encounter; (6) excess; (7) going; (8) killing, injuring &c.
पार (I) m.n. 1. The opposite bank of a river; 2. extremity, end.
पार (II) m. 1. The further side, the opposite side, K.S.ii.58; 2. the end or limit of anything; 3. quick-silver.

पार (III) n. The fullest extent, the totality of an object, स पूर्वजन्मांतरदृष्टपारः स्मरन्निवाक्लेशकरो गुरूणाम् R.xviii.50.(पारं गम्, इ, या &c. (1) to surmount; (2) to accomplish; (3) to be thoroughly conversant with.)
पारा f. Name of a river, ˚पारासरित्पारिकरच्छलतो बिभर्ति M.M.ix.
पर-अंग n. 1. the best limb; 2. the back part of the body.
पर-अंगद m. an epithet of Śiva.
पर-अदन m. a horse of the Persian breed.
पर-अधीन a. dependant, subservient, M.x.83.
पर-अंत m. pl. name of a people.
पर-अंतक m. an epithet of Śiva.
पर-अन्न (I) a. living on another’s food.
पर-अन्न (II) n. food of another.
पर-अन्न˚परिपुष्ट a. nourished by the food of another.
पर-अन्न˚भोजिन् a. eating the food of another.
पर-अपर (I) a. far and near, prior and posterior, before and behind, earlier and later, best and worst.
पर-अपर (II) n. a property intermediate between the greatest and smallest numbers, a species (in logic).
पार-अपार, -अवार (I) n. both banks of a river.
पर-अमृत n. rain.
पर-अयण (I) n. principal object, chief aim, best refuge, Bg.v.16, K.S.iv.1.
पर-अयण (II) a. 1. attached to, adhering to; 2. dependant on, subject to.
पार-अयण n. 1. going across; 2. reading through, perusing; 3. the whole, entireness, completeness.
पर-अर्थ (I) m. 1. the highest interest; 2. the interest of another; 3. the chief meaning; 4. the highest object.
पर-अर्थ (II) a. 1. done for another, designed for another, R.i.29; 2. having another aim or meaning.
पर-अर्ध n. 1. the other part, the latter half, दिनस्य पूर्वार्धपरार्धभिन्ना छायेव मैत्री खलसज्जनानाम् Bhartr.ii.60; 2. a particular high number (viz., 100,000,000,000,000,000).

पर-अर्ध्य (I) a. 1. most excellent, best, R.iii.27; 2. most costly, Sis.iv.11; 3. most beautiful, R.vi.4, Sis.iii.58; 4. most exalted, highly esteemed, R.viii.27, x.64; 5. most remote, most distant in number.
पर-अर्ध्य (II) n. a maximum.
पर-अवर a. 1. far and near, earlier and later, prior and subsequent, higher and lower &c. M.i.105; 2. all-including.
पार-अपार, -अवार (I) n. both banks of a river.
पार-अवार (II) m. the sea, the ocean, Bh.V.iv.11.
पर-अह m. the next day.
पर-अह्ण m. the afternoon, the latter part of the day.
पर-आचित a. brought up by another.
पर-आत्मन् m. the supreme spirit.
पर-आयत्त a. dependant upon another, subservient.
पर-आयुस् m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
पर-आविद्ध m. 1. an epithet of Kubera; 2. of Viṣṇu.
पर-आश्रय, -आसंग m. dependence upon another.
पर-आश्रय, -आसंग m. dependence upon another.
पर-आस्कंदिन् m. a thief, a robber.
पर-इतर a. another than inimical, i.e. friendly.
पर-ईश m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
पर-उत्कर्ष m. another’s prosperity.
पर-उपकार m. beneficence, benevolence, charity.
पर-उपजाप m. causing dissension among enemies.
पर-उपरुद्ध a. besieged by an enemy.
पर-ऊढा f. another’s wife.
पर-एधित (I) a. brought up by another.
पर-एधित (II) m. 1. a servant; 2. the Indian cuckoo.
पर-कलत्र n. another’s wife.
पर-कलत्र˚अभिगमन n. adultery.
पर-कार्य n. the affair of another, Bh.V.i.113.
पर-क्षेत्र n. 1. another’s body; 2. another’s field; 3. another’s wife, M.iii.175.
पर-गामिन् a. 1. relating to another; 2. beneficial to another.
पार-गत, -गामिन् a. ono who has passed to the other shore.
पर-ग्रंथि m. a finger-joint.
पर-चक्र n. 1. the army of an enemy; 2. a hostile campaign.
पर-च्छंद m. the will of another.
पर-च्छंद˚अनुवर्तन n. following the will of another.
पर-छिद्र n. a weak point of another, a defect in another.
परंज n. 1. an oil-mill; 2. the blade of a sword.
परंजन m. an epithet of Varuṇa.
परंजन m. an epithet of Varuṇa.
पर-जात (I) a. 1. born of another; 2. dependant on another for sustenance.
पर-जात (II) m. a servant.
पर-जित (I) a. conquered by another.
पर-जित (II) m. the Indian cuckoo.
पराजित a. (f. ता) 1. Conquered, defeated; 2. condemned by law.
पराजित a. (f. ता) 1. Conquered, defeated; 2. condemned by law.
पर-तंत्र a. dependant, subservient.
पर-तस् ind. 1. from another; 2. from an enemy, R.iii.48; 3. after, over, beyond; 4. otherwise, differently.
पर-त्र ind. 1. elsewhere, in a future birth, in another world, परत्रेह च शर्मणे R.i.69, K.S.iv.37; 2. further on, in the sequel.
पर-त्र˚भीरु m. a pious man (who stands in awe of the next world).
पर-दार m. pl. another’s wife.
पर-दारिन् m. an adulterer.
पर-दुःख n. the sorrow or misery of another, महदपि परदुःहं शीतलं सम्यगाहुः Vikr.iv.
पर-देश m. a foreign country.
पर-देशिन् m. a foreigner.
पर-द्रोहिन्, -द्वेषिन् a. hating others, hostile, inimical.
पर-द्रोहिन्, -द्वेषिन् a. hating others, hostile, inimical.
पर-धन n. another’s property.
पर-धर्म m. 1. another religion; 2. the duties of another caste, M.x.97.
पर-निपात m. the irregular posteriority of a word in a compound (as in राजदंत where the sense is दंतानां राजा) (in gram.).
परंतप a. subduing enemies, Bg.iv.2.
पर-पक्ष m. the side or party of an enemy.
पर-पद n. 1. the highest position; 2. final beatitude.
परस्मैपद n. one of the two modes (voiecs) in which Sanskrit verbs are conjugated. Cf. आत्मनेपद.
परस्मैभाषा f. one of the two modes (voiecs) in which Sanskrit verbs are conjugated. Cf. आत्मनेपद.
परंपर (I) a. successive, repeated.
परंपर (II) m. the son of a great grandson.

परंपरा f. 1. an uninterrupted scries, a succession, Bg.iv.2; (कर्णपरंपरया ‘through several ears (persons),’ ‘by hearsay.’ ‘to be handed down by succession’); 2. race, lineage; 3. a row, a line, a collection, an assemblage, R.vi.5, 35, 40, xii.50; 4. injury, hurting, killing.
परंपराक n. killing an animal at a sacrifice.
परंपरीण a. 1. hereditary; 2. traditional.
पारंपरीण a. (f. णी) Handed down from father to son, hereditary.
परस्पर (I) pron. (used in the singular only, e.g. परस्परस्योपरि पर्यचीयत R.iii.24) one another, each other, R.iii.79, vii.14.

परस्पर (II) a. mutual, परस्परां विस्मयवंति लक्ष्मीमालोकयांचकुरिवादरेण Bt.ii.5; (the acc., inst., and abl. singulars of this word are used as indeclinables in the sense of ‘with one another, from one another, to one another &c.’ Bg.iii.11)
पर-पिंड m. food belonging to another.
पर-पिंड˚अद m. one who eats another’s food, a servant.
पर-पिंड˚रत a. living upon others.
पर-पुरुष m. 1. the supreme spirit; 2. another man; 3. the husband of another woman.
पर-पुष्ट (I) a. nourished by another.
पर-पुष्ट (II) m. the Indian cuckoo.
पर-पुष्टा f. 1. the Indian cuckoo; 2. a harlot, a prostitute.
पर-पुष्ट˚महोत्सव m. the mango tree.
पर-पूर्वा f. a woman who has had a former husband.
पर-प्रेष्य m. a servant.
पर-ब्रह्मन् n. the supreme spirit.
पर-भाग m. 1. another’s share; 2. superior merit; 3. excellence, excess, abundance, अभाति लब्धपरभागतयाऽधरोष्ठे R.v.70, K.S.vii.17.
पर-भाषा f. a foreign language.
पर-भुक्त a. enjoyed by another.
पर-भृत् m. a crow.
पर-भृत (I) a. nourished by another.
पर-भृत (II) m. (fem. ˚ता) the Indian cuckoo (said to be nourished by the crow), R.ix.43, 47, K.S.vi.2.
पारभृत n. A present (probably a misreading for प्राभृत).
पर-मृत्यु m. a crow.
पर-रमण m. a married woman’s paramour.
पर-लोक m. the next world, K.S.iv.10.
पर-वत् a. dependent upon another, subject to another, (with a loc. or inst.), भ्रात्रा यदित्थं परवानसि त्वम् R.xiv.59, or भगवन् परवानयं जनः R.viii.81, ii.56, Sak.iii.
पर-वत्ता f. subjection, dependence.
पारवत m. A pigeon.
पारावत m. 1. A pigeon, a Turkey-pigeon, a dove, कस्यांचिद्भवनवलभौ सुप्तपारावतायाम् Megh.i.38; 2. a monkey; 3. a mountain.
पर-वश, -वश्य a. subject to another, dependant.
पर-वश, -वश्य a. subject to another, dependant.
पारवश्य n. Dependence, subservience.
पर-वाच्य n. a fault, a defect.
पर-वाणि m. 1. a judge; 2. a year; 3. name of Kārtikeya’s peacock.
पर-वाद m. 1. objection, refutation; 2. rumour, report.
पर-वादिन् m. a controversialist.
पर-व्रत m. an epithet of Dhṛtarāṣṭra.
पर-श्वस् ind. the day after tomorrow.
पर-संज्ञक m. the soul.
पर-सवर्ण a. homogenous with a following letter (in gram.)
पर-सेवा f. service of another.
पर-स्त्री f. another’s wife.
पर-स्व n. another’s property, R.ii.27.
पर-स्व˚हरण n. seizing another’s property.
पर-हन् a. killing enemies.
पर-हित n. the welfare of another.
परकीय a. (f. या) Belonging to another, यद्यपि न कापि हानिः परकीयां चरति रासभे द्राक्षाम् Ud.
परकीय a. (f. या) Belonging to another, यद्यपि न कापि हानिः परकीयां चरति रासभे द्राक्षाम् Ud.
परकीया f. A woman not one’s own (in poetic composition). For further information, See अन्यस्त्री.
परम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Highest, most excellent, प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम् M.iv.14; 2. chief, principal, primary, M.ix.319; 3. extreme, exceeding; 4. adequate, sufficient.
परम (II) n. The utmost, the chief part, कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः Bg.xvi.11.
परम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Highest, most excellent, प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम् M.iv.14; 2. chief, principal, primary, M.ix.319; 3. extreme, exceeding; 4. adequate, sufficient.
परम-अंगना f. an excellent woman.
परम-अणु m. an atom, an infinitesimal particle, R.xv.42, Yaj.iii.104.
परम-अद्वैत n. 1. pure unitarianism; 2. the supreme spirit.
परम-अन्न n. rice boiled in milk.
परम-अर्थ m. 1. the highest or most sublime truth, i.e. knowledge about Brahman (n.); 2. truth, reality, परिहासविजल्पितं सखे परमार्थेन न गृह्यतां वचः Sak.ii.; 3. any excellent object.
परम-अर्थ˚तस् ind. really, truly, properly, विकारं खलु परमार्थतोऽज्ञात्वा अनारंभः प्रतिकारस्य Sak.iii., उवाच चैनं परमार्थतो हरं न वेत्सि K.S.v.75.
परम-अर्थ˚मत्स्य m. a real fish, R.vii.40.
परम-अह m. an excellent day.
परम-आत्मन् m. the supreme spirit.
परम-आपद् f. the greatest misfortune.
परम-ईश m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
परम-ईश्वर m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. of Indra; 3. of Śiva; 4. the supreme being.
परम-ऋषि m. a great sage.
परम-ऐश्वर्य n. supremacy.
परम-गति f. final beatitude.
परम-गव m. an excellent bull or cow.
परम-पद n. 1. the highest rank; 2. final beatitude.
परम-पुरुष, -पूरुष m. the supreme spirit.
परम-पुरुष, -पूरुष m. the supreme spirit.
परम-प्रख्य a. renowned.
परम-ब्रह्मन् m. the supreme spirit.
परमेष्ठ m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
परमेष्ठिन् m. 1. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 2. of Śiva; 3. of Viṣṇu; 4. of Garuḍa.
परम-हंस m. an ascetic who has subdued all his senses by abstract meditation.
परमम् ind. A particle expressing- (1) permission; (2) assent or acceptance, ततः परममित्युक्त्वा प्रतस्थे मुनिमंडलम् K.S.vi.35.
परश m. A stone, the touch of which turns iron into gold, the philosopher’s stone.
पारस a. (f. सी) Persian.
परशव्य a. (f. व्या) Fit for a hatchet.
परशव्य a. (f. व्या) Fit for a hatchet.
परशु m. 1. A hatchet, a battle-axe, तर्जितः परशुधारया मम R.xi.78; 2. a weapon in general.
परासु a. Lifeless, dead, R.ix.78.
परशु-धर m. 1. an epithet of Paraśurāma; 2. of Gaṇeśa; 3. a soldier armed with an axe.
परश्व(स्व)ध m. A battle-axe, a hatchet, धारां शितां रामपरश्वधस्य संभावयत्युत्पलपत्रसाराम् R.vi.42.
परश्व(स्व)ध m. A battle-axe, a hatchet, धारां शितां रामपरश्वधस्य संभावयत्युत्पलपत्रसाराम् R.vi.42.
पारश्वध m. A man armed with an axe.
परस् ind. Beyond, further, more than, on the other side of, with the exception of &c. (not used by itself in classical Sanskrit).
परःकृष्ण a. extremely dark.
परस्-तात् ind. on the other side of, beyond, (with an abl. or gen., e.g. ग्रामात् or ग्रामस्य परस्तात्), आदित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् Bg.viii.9.
परःपुरुष a. higher than a man.
परःशत a. more than a hundred.
परःश्वस् ind. the day after tomorrow. Cf. परश्वस्.
परःसहस्र a. more than a thousand, तप्त्वा परःसहस्रा शरदस्तपांसि Ut.i.
पराकरण n. The act of rejecting or disregarding.
पराक्रम m. 1. Heroism, prowess, valour, M.i.51; 2. attempt, endeavour, enterprise; 3. a name of Viṣṇu.
पराग m. 1. Dust in general; 2. the pollen of a flower, Am.S.54; 3. fragrant powder used after bathing; 4. an eclipse of the sun or moon; 5. sandal; 6. independence.
पार-ग a. 1. going across; 2. completely familiar or conversant with, M.ii.148; 3. profoundly learned.
परांगव m. The ocean.
पराच् a. (f. ची) 1. Situated beyond or on the other side; 2. distant; 3. directed outwards.
पराच् a. (f. ची) 1. Situated beyond or on the other side; 2. distant; 3. directed outwards.

पराङ्मुख a. 1. having the face turned away, turning the back upon, विग्रहाच्च शयने पराह्मुखीर्नानुनेतुमबलाः स तत्वरे R.xix.38, Am.S.90; 2. averse from, मातुर्न केवलं स्वस्याः श्रियोऽप्यासीत् पराङ्मुखः R.xii.1; 3. unfavourable, तनुरपि न ते दोषोऽस्माकं विधिस्तु पराङ्मुखः Am.S.27; 4. not caring about, regardless of, मर्त्येऽवास्थापराङ्मुखः R.x.43.
पराचीन a. (f. ना) 1. Turned in an opposite direction; 2. not minding, not caring about; 3. happening subsequently; 4. situated on the other side.
पराचीन a. (f. ना) 1. Turned in an opposite direction; 2. not minding, not caring about; 3. happening subsequently; 4. situated on the other side.

पराजय m. 1. Overpowering, subjugating, defeating, defeat, R.xi.19; 2. the being overcome by, (with an abl., e.g. अध्ययनात्पराजयः); 3. loss, failure (as in a lawsuit), अन्यथावादिनो (साक्षिणः) यस्य ध्रुवस्तस्य पराजयः Yaj.ii.79.
परान(ण)सा f. Medical treatment, practice of medicine.
परान(ण)सा f. Medical treatment, practice of medicine.

पराभव m. 1. Defeat, discomfiture, overthrow; 2. mortification, humiliation, कुबेरस्य मनःशल्यं शंसतीव पराभवम् K.S.ii.22, तव पदपल्लववैरिपराभवमिदमनुभवतु सुवेशम् Git.G.xii.; 3. contempt, disregard, disrespect; 4. destruction. (The word is also, though very rarely, written पराभव.)

परि ind. (this word sometimes assumes the form परी, e.g. परिहास or परीहास and sometimes पलि, e.g. पर्यंक or पल्यंक) As a prefix to verbal themes, it means- (1) round, round about; (2) in addition to; (3) opposite to, against; (4) as much, excessively.As a separable preposition, it means- (1) towards, in the direction of, (with an acc., e.g. वृक्षं परि विद्योतते विद्युत्); (2) successively, severally, (with an acc., e.g. वृक्षं वृक्षं परि सिंचति ‘he waters tree after tree’); (3) participation, (with an acc., e.g. लक्ष्मीर्हरिं परि ‘Lakṣmī participates with Hari’); (4) except, with the exception of, (with an abl., e.g. परि त्रिगर्तेभ्यो वृष्टो देवः).As an adverbial prefix to nominal themes, it means ‘very, excessively,’ (e.g. पर्यश्रु).At the beginning of an adverbial compound, परि means- (1) without, outside, with the exception of, (e.g. परित्रिगर्तम्); (after अक्ष, शलाका or a numeral, परि may be used in this sense in an adverbial compound, to denote a lost game by an adverse die, e.g. अक्षपरि, शलाकापरि, एकपरि; (2) surrounded, round about, (e.g. पर्यग्नि).
